meta.title: Match Mismatch → Dispute Case Auto-Creation: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Open a 3-way/4-way match mismatch and trigger automatic dispute case creation
Verify refusal or absence for a user without the AP Executive role
Repeat the action as an AP Executive and verify it is available
